verdict.rationale: Algolia's official quickstart walks a developer through indexing sample data and building a working search over a sample product catalog. Independent users describe setup as easy, praise smooth onboarding, and report importing data with a simple script, which corroborates a fast path to a first search. Missing for 10: an explicit time-to-first-search claim or measurement proving 'within minutes', and a documented step-by-step index-creation and add-records flow outside the React-specific quickstart.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an index, add documents, and run my first search within minutes of starting the quickstart

citations.quote: Set up a React app, index sample data in Algolia, and build a search interface with React InstantSearch.
This quickstart builds a React app that searches a sample product catalog, filters by product type, and paginates results.
A former customer says Algolia is easy to use and set up
after importing data with a simple node script
